LanguageData.PMM_DoromeMudMerge_InvalidTarget: Must be revealed, natural ground — no floors, no deep water.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieOffer_Text_Bonded:
As {CLEANER_nameDef} cleans the dust from the old lamp, a genie swirls free in a rush of violet smoke! Bowing low before her rescuer, {GENIE_nameDef} offers to join the colony and bind herself to {CLEANER_nameDef} in a tsugai bond — his to ask for one wish a year, granted with all the power she has.
She will linger a few hours to savor her freedom, then wander on. Welcome her before she goes, or send her back into the smoke?
LanguageData.PMM_GenieOffer_Text_Unbound:
As {CLEANER_nameDef} cleans the dust from the old lamp, a genie swirls free in a rush of violet smoke! {GENIE_nameDef} owes her freedom to the colony and offers to join it — but her heart is unbound: only a man she forms a tsugai bond with can receive her wishes, one a year, at the price of nearly all her mana.
She will linger a few hours to savor her freedom, then wander on. Welcome her before she goes, or send her back into the smoke?
LanguageData.PMM_GenieJoined_Bonded: {PAWN_nameDef} the genie has joined the colony, binding herself to {MASTER_nameDef} in a tsugai bond! Her yearly wish is his to ask.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieJoined_Unbound: {PAWN_nameDef} the genie has joined the colony! Her heart is unbound — only a man she forms a tsugai bond with can receive her wish.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieWish_NoBond: {PAWN_labelShort} has no living tsugai husband in the colony — her wishes are for him alone.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieWish_NoMana: {PAWN_labelShort}'s mana is not full enough — a wish takes nearly all she has (95% required).
LanguageData.PMM_GenieWish_NotBondedTarget: A genie's wish is for her bonded master alone.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieWish_NothingToGrant: {PAWN_labelShort} has no missing limbs, no scars and no lasting sorrows — there is nothing to wish away.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieWish_Scar: The genie's magic smooths away one of {PAWN_possessive} old scars.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieWish_Mood: The genie's magic lifts "{THOUGHT}" from {PAWN_nameDef}'s heart.
LanguageData.PMM_GenieDeparted: {PAWN_nameDef} the genie has wandered off to enjoy her newfound freedom. Her offer has gone with her.
